scope: Repository capabilities and founder-reported local release acceptance; hosted operation and external validation are separate.

capabilities.title: Invite-only buyer/supplier identity
capabilities.limits: Captured local identity-email journeys accepted; external hosted inbox operation remains separate.

capabilities.title: Passkeys, recovery and team controls
capabilities.limits: Live permissions and reviewed recovery; this is not an independent penetration-test certificate.

capabilities.title: Reservation and quantity conservation
capabilities.limits: Transactional stock invariants and concurrency regressions; physical quantity remains a party record.

capabilities.title: Offer withdrawal, rejection and external negotiation boundary
capabilities.limits: Recorded offers do not provide an in-app counteroffer negotiation engine.

capabilities.title: Versioned bilateral base-record acknowledgement
capabilities.limits: Base commercial acknowledgement excludes separately confirmed payment terms; not a legal signature.

capabilities.title: Five manual payment-plan journeys and dispatch gates
capabilities.limits: Buyer submits and seller verifies; platform does not hold or move funds, provide escrow or authenticate banks.

capabilities.title: Exact recorded money versus broader currency policy
capabilities.limits: Exact arithmetic is implemented; corridor currencies, conversion and settlement approval are not universal.

capabilities.title: Incoterm authority, timing and exception awareness
capabilities.limits: All eleven product terms govern recording roles; no carrier verification, legal risk-transfer determination or external delivery guarantee.

capabilities.title: Buyer delivery acceptance and disputed-settlement hold
capabilities.limits: Partial settlement, refunds, paid cancellation and returned inventory remain separate work.

capabilities.title: Recall trading holds and guarded resolution
capabilities.limits: Recall closure does not automatically release retained or disposed inventory.

capabilities.title: Recall recipients, response and recovery operations
capabilities.limits: External nonmembers, automated response deadlines and separate physical disposition operation remain incomplete.

capabilities.title: Evidence-backed current trust presentation
capabilities.limits: Declaration is distinct from independent review; general assurance workflows and proactive revocation protection remain open.

capabilities.title: Private evidence storage, scanning and authorization
capabilities.limits: Local/S3-compatible storage and scanner exercised; independent hosted access review remains separate.

capabilities.title: Private current-state notification center
capabilities.limits: Current bounded feed with read receipts; not complete historical inbox or guaranteed outbound email.

capabilities.title: Contextual support references and saved filters
capabilities.limits: Presets are device-local per account/workspace; support does not promise staffed response times.

capabilities.title: Pagination, bounded exports and capacity
capabilities.limits: Explicit bounds avoid silently incomplete reports; measured hosted capacity and universal collection adoption remain open.

capabilities.title: English/French language foundation
capabilities.limits: Shell translation does not mean every trade flow or email is fully translated or reviewed.

capabilities.title: Isolated secure staging and production
capabilities.limits: Local release acceptance is not proof of provisioned hosted isolation, HTTPS, secrets or recovery operation.

capabilities.title: Complete authorization and independent security review
capabilities.limits: Checked entry guards and negative resource tests do not prove the universal role/resource/field matrix.

capabilities.title: Complete lifecycle email coverage
capabilities.limits: Identity, reminder and recall delivery exist; full trade-event coverage and external delivery acceptance remain open.

capabilities.title: Approved domestic and regional trade corridors
capabilities.limits: General product records do not establish jurisdictional, customs or commodity compliance.

capabilities.title: Verified logistics-provider discovery and fulfillment marketplace
capabilities.limits: Manual buyer/seller arrangements work; registered verified providers, selection, grants and adapters are roadmap work.

capabilities.title: Independent pilot use and fundraising evidence
capabilities.limits: No customer commitments, repeated usage or valuation are inferred from implementation or backlog completion.
